changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure [utility].[AddAuditEntry] @DependentObject varchar(50), @DependentObjectID int, @ResourceID int, @Date datetime, @Action varchar(15), @MainObject varchar(50), @MainObjectID int, @NewValue varchar(50) = null, @AuditFieldTable [dbo].[AuditFieldTable] readonly as begin set nocount on;
declare @ObjectName nvarchar(250), @ActionObjectName nvarchar(250), @ActionObjectTypeName nvarchar(250), @ActionDescription nvarchar(max), @ConvertMainObjectTypeName nvarchar(250), @auditID bigint, @Version int
select @Version = coalesce(max([Version]),0) + 1 from reporting.Global_Audit where Object = @MainObject and ObjectID = @MainObjectID
declare @tbl table (FieldTypeID int default(0), FieldName nvarchar(250), NewValue nvarchar(max), PreviousValue nvarchar(max), Updated bit default(0));
if @DependentObject is not null begin if @DependentObject = 'Group' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from [Group] where ID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'IssueType' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from IssueType where ID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'IntersectType' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from dbo.GetIntersectTypeNames(@DependentObjectID) end else if @DependentObject = 'ReferenceItemType' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from AssetType where [Object] = @DependentObject and ObjectID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'Report' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from Report where ID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'ResponsibilityType' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from ResponsibilityType where ID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'SurveyType' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from SurveyType where ID = @DependentObjectID end else if @DependentObject = 'Tag' begin select @ActionObjectName = Value from Tag where ID = @DependentObjectID end else begin if @DependentObject like '%Type' begin select @ActionObjectName = Name from AssetType where [Object] = @DependentObject and ObjectID = @DependentObjectID end else begin select @ActionObjectName = DisplayValue from AssetDetail where [Object] = @DependentObject and ObjectID = @DependentObjectID end end end;
if @MainObject in ('Artifact', 'Policy', 'ReferenceItem', 'Rule', 'Taxonomy') begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = A.TypeName, @ObjectName = A.DisplayValue from AssetDetail A where A.[Object] = @MainObject and A.ObjectID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject in ('ArtifactType', 'PolicyType', 'ReferenceItemType', 'TaskType', 'TaxonomyType') begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = case Class when 1 then 'Business' when 2 then 'Model' when 6 then 'Policy' when 7 then 'Rule' when 8 then 'Technical' when 9 then 'Reference' when 14 then 'Reference' else 'Unknown' end + ' Asset Type', @ObjectName = Name from AssetType where [Object] = @MainObject and ObjectID = @MainObjectID;
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from AssetType cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('Notes', cast(Notes as nvarchar(max))), ('DisplayFormat', cast(DisplayFormat as nvarchar(max))), ('DescriptionButtonName', cast(DescriptionButtonName as nvarchar(max))), ('HierarchyMaximumDepth', cast(HierarchyMaximumDepth as nvarchar(max))), ('DefaultPermissions', cast(DefaultPermissions as nvarchar(max))), ('UseAsTransformation', cast(iif(UseAsTransformation = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('AutoDisplayParent', cast(iif(AutoDisplayParent = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('CanEditParent', cast(iif(CanEditParent = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsDescriptionEnabled', cast(iif(IsDescriptionEnabled = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsDescriptionVisibleByDefault', cast(iif(IsDescriptionVisibleByDefault = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where Object = @MainObject and ObjectID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'FieldType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Field Type', @ObjectName = FriendlyName from FieldType where ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from [FieldType] cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('FriendlyName', cast(FriendlyName as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('DisplayDescription', cast(DisplayDescription as nvarchar(max))), ('FormDescription', cast(FormDescription as nvarchar(max))), ('Type', cast(Type as nvarchar(max))), ('LookupObjectType', cast(LookupObjectType as nvarchar(max))), ('LookupObjectID', cast(LookupObjectID as nvarchar(max))), ('LookupDisplayFormat', cast(LookupDisplayFormat as nvarchar(max))), ('MinimumLength', cast(MinimumLength as nvarchar(max))), ('MaximumLength', cast(MaximumLength as nvarchar(max))), ('Length', cast(Length as nvarchar(max))), ('SortOrder', cast(SortOrder as nvarchar(max))), ('Category', cast(Category as nvarchar(max))), ('ColumnOrder', cast(ColumnOrder as nvarchar(max))), ('ColumnWidth', cast(ColumnWidth as nvarchar(max))), ('DefaultFormattedValue', cast(DefaultFormattedValue as nvarchar(max))), ('IsPrimaryFilter', cast(iif(IsPrimaryFilter = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('ShowIfEmpty', cast(iif(ShowIfEmpty = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsRequired', cast(iif(IsRequired = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsListable', cast(iif(IsListable = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsDisplayable', cast(iif(IsDisplayable = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsEditable', cast(iif(IsEditable = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('IsPartOfKey', cast(iif(IsPartOfKey = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))), ('AllowMultipleValues', cast(iif(AllowMultipleValues = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'Group' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Group', @ObjectName = O.Name from [Group] O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from [Group] cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('PrimaryOwnerResourceID', cast(PrimaryOwnerResourceID as nvarchar(max))), ('SecondaryOwnerResourceID', cast(SecondaryOwnerResourceID as nvarchar(max))), ('IsActiveDirectoryGroup', cast(iif(IsActiveDirectoryGroup = 1, 'true', 'false') as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'Intersect' begin set @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Relationship' set @ObjectName = '$IntersectName' end
if @MainObject = 'IntersectType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Relationship Type', @ObjectName = ITyName.Name from IntersectType O cross apply dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(O.ID) ITyName where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Name', Name from dbo.getIntersectTypeNames(@MainObjectID) insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'SubjectCardinality', SubjectCardinality from IntersectType O where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'ObjectCardinality', ObjectCardinality from IntersectType O where ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'IssueType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Action Type', @ObjectName = O.Name from IssueType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from IssueType cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'QuestionType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = T.Name, @ObjectName = O.Name from QuestionType O inner join SurveyType T on T.ID = O.SurveyTypeID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from QuestionType cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('DisplayStyle', cast(DisplayStyle as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'ReferenceItem' begin insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from Asset cross apply ( values ('Code', cast(Code as nvarchar(max))), ('Color', cast(Color as nvarchar(max))), ('Icon', cast(Icon as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where Object = @MainObject and ObjectID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'Report' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Report', @ObjectName = O.Name from Report O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from Report cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('ReportType', cast(ReportType as nvarchar(max))), ('AssetTypeID', cast(AssetTypeID as nvarchar(max))), ('Location', cast(AssetTypeID as nvarchar(max))), ('Definition', cast(AssetTypeID as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'Resource' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'User', @ObjectName = A.FirstName + ' ' + A.LastName from reporting.Global_Resource A where A.ResourceID = @MainObjectID
end
if @MainObject = 'Tag' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Tag', @ObjectName = T.Value from Tag T where T.Id = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from Tag cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Value as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'ResponsibilityType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type', @ObjectName = O.Name from ResponsibilityType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from ResponsibilityType cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('ResponsibilityTypeGroup', cast(ResponsibilityTypeGroup as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type Override', @ObjectName = RT.Name from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem O left join ResponsibilityType RT on O.ResponsibilityTypeID = RT.ID where O.ID = @MainObjectID
if not exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID) begin set @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Responsibility Type Override' set @ObjectName = '(Responsibility Type Removed)' end
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Name', Name from ResponsibilityType where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Responsibility Type', Name from ResponsibilityType where ID = (select ResponsibilityTypeID from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID) insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Context', Context from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem where ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Group', g.Name from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem r inner join [Group] g on g.id = r.securityassetid where r.SecurityAsset = 'G' and r.ID = @MainObjectID insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'User', gr.FirstName + ' ' + gr.LastName from ResponsibilityTypeRelationOverrideItem r inner join reporting.[Global_Resource] gr on gr.ResourceID = r.securityassetid where r.SecurityAsset = 'R' and r.ID = @MainObjectID end
if @MainObject = 'SurveyType' begin select @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Survey Type', @ObjectName = O.Name from SurveyType O where O.ID = @MainObjectID
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select FieldName, NewValue from SurveyType cross apply ( values ('Name', cast(Name as nvarchar(max))), ('Description', cast(Description as nvarchar(max))), ('AssetTypeID', cast(AssetTypeID as nvarchar(max))), ('ValidForDays', cast(ValidForDays as nvarchar(max))) ) c (FieldName, NewValue) where ID = @MainObjectID; end
if @MainObject = 'CompanySettings' begin set @ActionObjectTypeName = @MainObject set @ActionObjectName = @MainObject set @ObjectName = @DependentObject
insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) values (@DependentObject, @NewValue) end
if (@Action = 'Created') begin insert into @tbl (FieldTypeID, FieldName, NewValue) select FieldTypeID, FieldName as FriendlyName, Value as FormattedValue from @AuditFieldTable where [value] is not null and [value] != '' end else begin insert into @tbl (FieldTypeID, FieldName, NewValue) select FieldTypeID, FieldName as FriendlyName, Value as FormattedValue from @AuditFieldTable end
if @DependentObject is not null and @MainObject = 'Tag' and @MainObjectID = 0 begin insert into @tbl (FieldName, NewValue) select 'Tags', string_Agg(T.Value, ', ') from Asset A inner join AssetTag TA on TA.AssetID = A.ID and A.Object = @DependentObject and A.ObjectID = @DependentObjectID inner join Tag T on T.ID = TA.TagID
set @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Tags' set @ObjectName = 'Tag' end
-- this is the case where the last value of a field was removed and the asset remains its not the asset being deleted just an update. if @Action = 'Removed' and exists(select 1 from asset where [object] = @DependentObject and [ObjectID] = @DependentObjectID) begin set @Action = 'Updated'; end
set @ConvertMainObjectTypeName = @ActionObjectTypeName;
declare @ShouldAudit bit = 0;
if @Action in ('Added', 'Created') begin update @tbl set Updated = 1; set @ActionDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' created' set @ShouldAudit = 1; end if @Action in ('Deleted', 'Removed') begin set @ActionDescription = @ConvertMainObjectTypeName + ' removed' set @ShouldAudit = 1; end if @Action in ('Updated') begin -- Determines if the new value is different from the last updated value. If so, this should be included as part of the audit. update T set T.Updated = 1, T.PreviousValue = S.Value from @tbl T cross apply ( select top 1 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.Object, a.ObjectID, iif(f.FieldTypeID = 0, f.FieldName, f.FieldTypeID) ORDER BY f.[AuditId] DESC) as RowNum, [Value] from reporting.Global_FieldAudit f inner join reporting.Global_Audit a on a.ID = f.AuditID and a.Object = @MainObject and a.ObjectID = @MainObjectID and ( (f.FieldTypeID = T.FieldTypeID and T.FieldTypeID <> 0) or (f.FieldName = T.FieldName and T.FieldTypeID = 0) ) ) S
if @ActionObjectTypeName = 'Tag' begin set @ActionDescription = @ActionObjectTypeName + ' updated' end
if exists(select 1 from @tbl where Updated = 1) begin set @ShouldAudit = 1; end end if @Action = 'Tag Consolidate' begin set @ActionDescription = 'Tag consolidated' set @ShouldAudit = 1; end if @Action = 'Update settings' begin set @ActionDescription = 'Updating company settings' set @ShouldAudit = 1; end
if @ShouldAudit = 1 begin insert into reporting.Global_Audit ( Object, ObjectID, ObjectName, ResourceID, [Date], [Action], ActionObject, ActionObjectID, ActionObjectTypeName, ActionObjectName, ActionDescription, [Version] ) values ( @MainObject, @MainObjectID, coalesce(@ObjectName, ''), coalesce(@ResourceID, 0), @Date, @Action, @DependentObject, @DependentObjectID, coalesce(@ActionObjectTypeName, ''), coalesce(@ActionObjectName,''), coalesce(@ActionDescription,''), @Version );
select @auditID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
insert into reporting.Global_FieldAudit ( AuditID, FieldTypeID, FieldName, Value, PreviousValue ) select @auditID, FieldTypeID, FieldName, NewValue, PreviousValue from @tbl where Updated = 1; end end
